source_label: Claude Platform pricing docs (model pricing table)
note: Anthropic 定价文档模型表 Claude Sonnet 5 行,原样抄录(per MTok):Base Input $2、5m Cache Write $2.50、1h Cache Write $4、Cache Hit/Refresh $0.20(按 0.1x 基准输入价)、Output $10。表下脚注全文:「The $2/$10 per million input/output token pricing for Claude Sonnet 5, announced at launch as introductory pricing through August 31, 2026, is now the standard price. The previously scheduled increase to $3/$15 per million input/output tokens on September 1, 2026 will not occur.」——即 8-31 到期后未回升,促销价转为标准价。交叉验证:www.anthropic.com/pricing 营销页同日读数 Sonnet 5 分区同为 $2/$10/$0.20(缓存写 $2.50),无任何 intro/through 字样,两页一致。批次范围与交叉验证:同页 Opus 5 为 $5/$25/$0.50、Haiku 4.5 为 $1/$5/$0.10,与目录现值逐一相同,证明读的是同一张表、同一档位;Fable 5.1($10/$50)不在目录,仅记为上下文。batch-10 的 $3/$15 行未被改动——那是 8-31 前有效的旧标准价,证据链保留,由 supersededRows 路由。
